in_sanskrit.name: सहैव्या
in_sanskrit.meaning: सह इवा (सह + इवा) = साथ रखनेवाला (one who keeps company)
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Shaivya is derived from the Sanskrit words 'सह' (sah) meaning 'with' and 'इवा' (iva) meaning 'one who'. The name Shaivya, therefore, means 'one who keeps company'.

in_hindi.name: शैव्या
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Shaivya in Hindi is 'शैव्या' (shai-vyaa), which means 'one who keeps company'.

in_tamil.name: சைவ்யா
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Shaivya in Tamil is 'சைவ்யா' (cai-vyaa), which means 'one who stays or resides in a place'. This meaning, while different from the Sanskrit and Hindi meanings, is still related to the idea of companionship or keeping company.

in_telugu.name: శైవ్యా
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Shaivya in Telugu is 'శైవ్యా' (shai-vyaa), which means 'one who is always with or accompanies'. This meaning is consistent with the Sanskrit and Hindi meanings.
